spine.entity: one smart-card journey on the metro, from check-in to check-out
spine.source: synthetic (constructed operator extract, declared in metadata.json)

world.geography: Netherlands (a fictional city, Ravelmond, and its three-line metro)

driver: The decisive quantity is how many members of a population pass a set of points a given number of times over a period, when the record logs each member only where it enters and leaves and the points passed in between depend on how the service ran at that hour, which at the busiest hours differed from the published network; placing the in-between points from the published network credits passes to members who never made them and misses members who did, and only each journey's own duration against the network's timings shows which happened.
driver_concrete: Each package's effective reach counts the regular riders who passed its screens three or more times in the four autumn weeks; the halls come from the check-in and check-out gates, and the central interchange passage from the journeys that changed trains there, which at the weekday peaks are the north-south and west-east journeys (the north branch's trains run through to the east branch and the west's to the south) and off the peak the north-east and south-west ones, shown only by each journey's duration against the network's run and walking times.
stump: The default path places every change of trains where the line map puts it and credits the central interchange passage with the north-east and south-west commuters, filing Tier G for Centraal, Binnenstad, Overstappunten, Oosttak and Zuidtak (Centraal 63 per cent); at the weekday peaks those commuters stay on through trains and the north-south and west-east commuters change instead, which only the journeys' durations show, so Centraal and Binnenstad fall to 33 per cent and Tier G is Overstappunten, Zuidtak and Oosttak.

differentiation.task451: task451 completes a period total not yet observed from how amounts arrive (a sender's delay and a handler's delay that collapsed); here nothing is incomplete or late: every journey is recorded in full, and the decisive step is placing the passes between its two gates by the service it actually rode
differentiation.task135: task135 estimates the variance of a weighted sum from components struck at different times of day; here the time of day decides which train service a journey rode and so where its rider passed, and the graded quantity is a count of riders over a frequency threshold, not a variance
differentiation.task161: task161 draws down stock built ahead of a cost step at each holder's use share; here no stock or drawdown exists: the decisive step reads, journey by journey, whether the rider changed trains at an interchange from the journey's own duration
differentiation.task460: task460 sets what a new zero-rate source removes from a system total by the units responding at the margin interval by interval; here the intervals are the operator's peak and off-peak service and the quantity is how many riders pass a set of points, read journey by journey
differentiation.task255: architecture 1 fitted an occurrence-severity tail through truncation, censoring and a coverage mixture; this architecture counts riders over an exposure-frequency threshold from journeys whose intermediate passes are placed by the service each journey rode, with no fitted distribution at all

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the upper tail of a size distribution whose items reach the record only above a floor that differs from item to item and are recorded only up to a ceiling that moved during the record, so the fit has to carry each item's floor as truncation and the ceiling as censoring, both at the cost level the curve is fitted at; fitting the recorded sizes as a complete sample thins the tail and sets the dial two steps too low, and treating only the ceiling still leaves it a step and more short.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the upper tail of a size distribution whose items reach the record only above a floor that differs from item to item and are recorded only up to a ceiling that moved during the record, and whose largest items stay unfinished long after the small ones finish; the fit has to carry each item's floor as truncation and the ceiling as censoring at the fitted cost level over every item of the window, the unfinished ones included as the censored observations they are, because fitting only the finished items selects on size and thins the tail a step short, and fitting the recorded sizes as complete thins it more.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the upper tail of a size distribution made of two kinds of item whose tails differ by far more than their bulk, with the expected number above a low anchor projected separately for each kind; the record identifies both tails once each kind is fitted on its own through the record's floor and ceiling, and the count above each high threshold is the sum of each kind's anchor times its own tail ratio, while one curve fitted to the pooled record is shaped by the short-tailed majority and puts the dial two steps too low.
